question: In the 7th Century AD, a new religion called Islam was born in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arabia**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• In the 7th Century AD, a new religion called **Islam** was born in **Arabia**, specifically in the city of **Mecca** (in present-day Saudi Arabia).
 
• Islam was founded by the Prophet **Muhammad**, who is regarded by Muslims as the last messenger of God.
 
• The core teachings of Islam are based on the revelations Muhammad received, which are compiled in the holy book called the **Quran**.
 
• The r**eligion emphasizes monotheism, the worship of one God (Allah), and a framework for personal conduct, spirituality, and community life.**
